overview: This bill renames the main playground in the Grandview area of New River Gorge National Park and Preserve in West Virginia. It would be called the "Hearts of Gold Playground: In Honor of West Virginia Children and Families Impacted by Childhood Cancer," and all federal maps and records would use the new name. The bill does not change how the park or playground is run. The Senate passed it on September 23, 2026, and as of September 24, 2026, it was being held at the desk in the House, waiting for possible action there.
for: Supporters say the name honors West Virginia children and families affected by childhood cancer and gives them a lasting place of recognition in a national park.
against: Critics say the bill is symbolic and does not change any law or spending, and some may question using an act of Congress to rename a single playground.
